description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableAttributes' implementing the 'Attributes' interface, providing methods to manipulate immutable JSON-backed attribute collections within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributes
classes.description: Immutable implementation of Attributes interface that wraps a JsonObject and provides a variety of methods for attribute manipulation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty Attributes instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an Attributes instance from a JsonObject, validating keys.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a long integer.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped JSON value is null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as an int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a String.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonObject.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonArray.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a given key, accepting different data types.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets specific fields based on JsonFieldDefinition or JsonField.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Inserts multiple fields into attributes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from attributes.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonObject by pointer or field selector.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the value associated with a key or field definition.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a value or throws if not present.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns list of keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonField for a key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the attributes are empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over JsonFields.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of JsonFields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Attributes to a JsonObject.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes the JSON representation to a SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns an estimate of maximum string size.
